Gold and Silver Prices See Significant Drop

On Monday, September 7, 2026, gold and silver prices experienced a notable decline. In Haryana, 22-carat gold was priced at ₹14,290 per gram and 24-carat gold at ₹15,005 per gram. Silver was trading around ₹2.67 lakh per kilogram. The price of silver saw a drop of over ₹1200 in a single day, making it ₹1.83 lakh cheaper than its peak price per kilogram. Gold prices also decreased.
